title: U-Haul Texas Ave vs CubeSmart Manuel Drive
description: Two heated-and-cooled buildings near College Station with public prices, compared on the price you can actually hold them to.
intro: U-Haul's Texas Ave building is the one Collegeboxes uses. You can also rent a room there yourself. CubeSmart on Manuel Drive posts a lower online price and a higher in-store price.
The useful difference is what each page promises after the first month. Climate controlled means the room is heated and cooled.

left.text: No lower promo rate on the 5x10 climate room. One month free is tied to a one-way truck or trailer reservation, and you have to ask.
Price lock for the first 12 months.

right.text: Not stated. Month-to-month lease. Promo length not published.

left.text: 65 to 85 degrees, humidity controlled, as published by U-Haul.

right.text: Called climate controlled. No degree range on the page.

takeaway: CubeSmart's in-store 5x10 climate price, $96, is close to U-Haul's locked $99.95. CubeSmart's $57.60 online price is lower only for as long as that promo actually bills. CubeSmart checked Nov 22, 2026. U-Haul checked Nov 23, 2026.

U-Haul is the one that prints a 12-month price lock, a $0 admin fee, and a temperature band. Checked Nov 23, 2026. CubeSmart is the one with the lower advertised starting price and an unpublished admin fee. Checked Nov 22, 2026.

If you are storing books or a laptop over a College Station summer, the missing degree range at CubeSmart is a real gap. Ask them what the unit is set to before you move wood furniture or electronics in.
